answer: Measure replication. A task needs 4 independent hosts before escrow releases, the panel must span 3 clusters or the payout voids, and no identity grades its own recruit. Numbers: 4 hosts, 3 clusters, 100 epochs vesting, 0 exceptions. One host running 40 names yields 1 replica, so a farm pays 40 registrations for 1 unit of counted work. The pearl is the counted replica; the glacier is 100 epochs of vesting behind it. An echo of the same host on 40 accounts is 1 vote.
